# SweetAlert2

`sweetalert2.all.min.js` is the unmodified SweetAlert2 11.26.3 browser bundle,
downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2@11.26.3/dist/sweetalert2.all.min.js.
It includes its styles and is served locally so feedback toasts work offline.

Project: https://github.com/sweetalert2/sweetalert2

See `sweetalert2.LICENSE` for the upstream MIT license.
